answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks through verifiable environmental spectrometry. Nodes surveying a shared meadow deploy a microfluidic quill to sample local minerals like powdered jade. The resulting spectral signature is cryptographically bound to the public key of each node. An attacker incurs the verifiable manufacturing and deployment cost of dedicated robotic hardware per identity. However, natural mineral variation across terrain can trigger false rejections of honest nodes.
